product_of_canada.label: Product of Canada
product_of_canada.explain: All or nearly all (≈98%+) ingredients, processing and labour are Canadian.

made_in_canada.label: Made in Canada (with imported ingredients)
made_in_canada.explain: Last major transformation happened in Canada, but some ingredients/components are imported.

canadian_owned.label: Canadian-owned company
canadian_owned.explain: The company is Canadian-owned, but the product may be made elsewhere or with imported inputs.

imported.label: Imported
imported.explain: Made outside Canada by a non-Canadian company.

unknown.label: Origin not confirmed
unknown.explain: We couldn't confirm where this is made. This does not mean it is bad — only unknown.
